_about: KNOWN, DIAGNOSED divergences between the two schema-validation engines the dual-oracle gate (conformance/selfcheck/validate_dual_oracle.py) runs on every schema check: the official Rust `ucp-schema` oracle (SOURCES.lock.json schema_validator) and the independent Python jsonschema referee (dual_oracle_referee.py). A divergence means one engine's VERDICT (valid vs invalid, or which instance path is faulted) disagrees with the other on a payload both actually validate. Every divergence is one of three valuable signals: (a) our check is wrong, (b) the Rust oracle is wrong (upstream bug), (c) the referee is wrong. The gate ALARMS (fails) on any divergence NOT listed here. An entry here is an ACKNOWLEDGED oracle bug we have already diagnosed and filed upstream, so the suite does not re-fail on it every run. RULES, identical in spirit to known_reference_defects.json: (1) Nothing may be listed without an `upstream` link — an entry without one is suppression, not acknowledgement. (2) Entries EXPIRE BY CONSTRUCTION — the gate reproduces each entry every run against its tagged corpus items; once the divergence stops reproducing (the pinned oracle in SOURCES.lock.json advances past the fix, or the schema changes), the gate FAILS on the now-stale acknowledgement until the entry is deleted, so a fixed bug cannot quietly keep its acknowledgement. This is the compensating coverage that closes the oracle blind-spot follow-up: the divergence a trusted oracle can silently pass is now a first-class, self-expiring gate. VERSIONING + PIN EXPIRY (D4-01, B5a): `versions` lists the spec versions whose corpus must reproduce the entry (absent = all); `class` is `verdict` (valid-vs-invalid split) or `oracle-crash` (the Rust oracle exits with a code outside {0,1} — an abort on the `$ref: "#"` self-root blind spot); `expires_on.schema_validator_pin_not` names the buggy oracle pin the acknowledgement was made against — the gate FAILS `STALE ACKNOWLEDGEMENT (pin moved)` the moment the build serving a listed version (conformance/ci/oracle_manifest.json per_version, D4-04; the 2026-04-08 entry equals SOURCES.lock schema_validator.commit) is no longer that pin, independently of reproduction. RETIRED 2026-09-11 (D4-04): ucp-schema-45-selfroot-def-crash — the 2026-08-25 layout now runs the merged-main b52518f5 build (contains #66), on which `--def selected_payment_instrument` validates (rc 0) and the #43 boundary agrees; the crash class is guarded by oracle_verdict_diff.py (0 crash on the assigned build's own corpus) and the manifest's known_blind_spots.

divergences.summary: The Rust bundler leaves a `$ref: "#"` dangling when inlining a fragment (src/loader.rs:185-187, compose.rs:677). On the checkout payment path (checkout.json -> payment.json -> types/payment_instrument.json#/$defs/selected_payment_instrument, whose allOf[0] is {"$ref": "#"} meaning payment_instrument.json's OWN root), `#` binds to the inlining file after bundling instead of payment_instrument.json, so `payment.instruments[*]` is never validated against the base `required: [id, handler_id, type]`. The independent referee resolves `#` against the containing resource's $id (correct per 2020-12), so it enforces the base schema. Divergence is bidirectional: (false-accept) an instrument missing id/handler_id/type, or with non-string values in them, validates clean on the Rust oracle but the referee rejects it at /payment/instruments/*; (false-reject) a spec-valid instrument carrying an extra property named `instruments` is rejected by the Rust oracle (# resolved to payment.json, which types that name as an array) but accepted by the referee. Fix #44 resolves self-root refs against their source file when bundling. Diagnosis, reproduction and referee build: this week's ucp-schema#43/#44.
divergences.triage: ACKNOWLEDGED oracle bug (signal b). The compensating coverage IS this gate + the referee. SELF-EXPIRES: when SOURCES.lock.json schema_validator is re-pinned past #44 and the oracle rebuilt, the tagged boundary payloads agree, this entry stops reproducing, and the gate fails until this entry is deleted.
